audit.why: 53.59% Emerald+ over 2879 games supports the FAVOURED framing.
Favoured lane: an all-dash assassin into the anti-dash mage. Difficulty 4/10 reasonable.
Spike structure right, but the ability slots inside the spikes are scrambled (see point 4).

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] calls Darkin Daggers (Q) a 'dash-in engage' — it is her dagger throw; her dash is Eviscerate (E). spikes[1] and mid label Hounds' Pursuit as (E) and Call of the Pack as (R): really W is The Call of the Pack, E is Eviscerate, R is Hounds' Pursuit. Missing: her W makes her untargetable (26-18s CD) and her E heals the packmates — anti-heal and don't-burst-into-untargetability both matter.
audit.corrected: Slot labels corrected in spikes[0], spikes[1], mid; untargetable window and 110/95/80 R numbers added to cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Naafiri called he/his across many fields; two copy-paste bleed bullets.
audit.corrected: Flagged fields rewritten she/her; bleed bullets replaced with title-matched bodies.

audit.why: Missing interactions (untargetable W/R windows, packmate heal wanting anti-heal, R second-cast shield) folded into cooldowns, dosFull and report[8] edits.
